items.title: Quasi-coherent sheaves on an algebraic space form a Grothendieck abelian category and the inclusion has a right adjoint
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The proposition proves that the category of quasi-coherent sheaves on an algebraic space is a Grothendieck abelian category, hence has enough injectives and all limits, and that the inclusion into all modules has a right adjoint whose adjunction map is an isomorphism on quasi-coherent sheaves (statement lines 6023-6040). The proof (proof lines 6042-6105) verifies the Grothendieck conditions using the closure lemma, constructs a generator from a presentation by an etale groupoid scheme with the boundedness results for compatible systems, and builds the right adjoint by Brown representability of a Hom functor. H3: three independent constructions with several inputs, written out in full.
